decisions.reason: The firm increased its public commitment by giving this close-to-core module its own page in 2024, and with sunk development costs already incurred management is likely to keep it and read any slow uptake as temporary.

This module sits squarely in the established automation portfolio, has been presented on its own page across both years, and a growing, R&D-oriented firm would be inclined to justify that investment by continuing it.

Although the website commitment looks lighter because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it still fits the modular electronics system well, so escalation of commitment makes continued offering more likely than withdrawal.

As a recent 2024 launch with only modest visible promotion it has some risk, but because it builds on the existing platform and the firm is expanding rather than retrenching, management would likely give it more time before dropping it.

This service is closely tied to the firm's stated strategic push in charging and energy management, so both strategic centrality and public commitment make management especially likely to persist with it.
